claims.text: The __main__ guard delegates to cli.main and raises SystemExit with its return value.
The entry imports main from .cli and the module docstring states it runs the mechanically extracted CLI.

decision.rule: Change here when the CLI entrypoint or its exit behavior needs to change.
decision.failure: Module execution misroutes or exit codes are lost.

questions.q: Where is the CLI main imported and invoked?
What exit code does the entrypoint propagate?
